note: A starting set of evidence requests, not a complete audit programme. Control identifiers with short paraphrases written for this repository; the standards' text is not reproduced. Agree the list with your assessor.

control_topics.A.5.1: Security policies exist, are approved and reach the people they apply to
control_topics.A.5.15: Access to systems and data follows defined rules
control_topics.A.5.16: Identities are managed through their whole life
control_topics.A.5.17: Passwords, keys and other secrets are handled and rotated with care
control_topics.A.5.18: Access is granted, reviewed and removed on purpose
control_topics.A.5.2: Security roles and responsibilities are defined and assigned
control_topics.A.5.22: Supplier services are monitored and reviewed
control_topics.A.5.23: Cloud services are chosen, used and left under control
control_topics.A.5.24: Incident handling is planned and prepared
control_topics.A.5.26: Incidents are responded to as planned
control_topics.A.5.27: Lessons from incidents are used to improve
control_topics.A.5.30: Systems are ready to continue or recover
control_topics.A.5.36: Policies and standards are checked for compliance
control_topics.A.5.9: An inventory of information and related assets is kept
control_topics.A.6.1: Candidates are checked before they join
control_topics.A.6.2: Staff agree to their security duties in writing
control_topics.A.6.5: Security duties continue to apply after people leave or change role
control_topics.A.8.1: Company data on laptops and phones is protected through device management
control_topics.A.8.13: Copies of data and systems exist and restoring them is tried
control_topics.A.8.15: Systems keep a tamper-resistant record of who did what
control_topics.A.8.16: Systems are watched for unusual or hostile activity
control_topics.A.8.2: Administrative access is kept to few people and watched
control_topics.A.8.24: Encryption is used and its keys are managed
control_topics.A.8.25: Security is part of how software is built
control_topics.A.8.29: Automated tests run before changes are accepted
control_topics.A.8.3: Access to information is limited to what the job needs
control_topics.A.8.32: Changes go through a reviewed, recorded process
control_topics.A.8.5: Sign-in uses strong methods such as multi-factor authentication
control_topics.A.8.7: Systems are protected against malicious software
control_topics.A.8.8: Known software weaknesses are found and fixed in time
control_topics.A.8.9: System settings are recorded and drift is noticed
control_topics.A1.2: Backup and recovery capability supports availability commitments
control_topics.CC1.1: The organisation shows commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_topics.CC1.4: People with security duties are hired, trained and kept competent
control_topics.CC2.2: Security responsibilities are communicated inside the organisation
control_topics.CC3.2: Risks to the objectives are identified and assessed
control_topics.CC4.1: Controls are checked on an ongoing or periodic basis
control_topics.CC5.3: Policies set out what is expected and are put into practice
control_topics.CC6.1: Logical access is controlled with identities, strong sign-in and access rules
control_topics.CC6.2: Accounts are created and removed through an approved process
control_topics.CC6.3: Access follows roles and least privilege and is reviewed
control_topics.CC6.6: Connections from outside the system boundary are restricted
control_topics.CC6.8: Unauthorised or harmful software is prevented or detected
control_topics.CC7.1: Weaknesses and risky configuration changes are detected
control_topics.CC7.2: Systems are monitored for signs of attack or failure
control_topics.CC7.3: Security events are evaluated to decide if they are incidents
control_topics.CC7.4: Incidents are responded to, contained and recovered from
control_topics.CC7.5: Recovery from incidents is carried out and learned from
control_topics.CC8.1: Changes are approved, tested and recorded before they go live
control_topics.CC9.2: Vendors and partners are assessed and monitored

requests.title: AWS IAM credential report
requests.how: aws iam generate-credential-report, then aws iam get-credential-report --query Content --output text, decoded from base64 and saved as CSV

requests.title: AWS account password policy and account summary
requests.how: aws iam get-account-password-policy --output json; aws iam get-account-summary --output json

requests.title: AWS CloudTrail trails and logging status
requests.how: aws cloudtrail describe-trails --output json; aws cloudtrail get-trail-status --name <trail> --output json

requests.title: AWS GuardDuty detectors and findings summary
requests.how: aws guardduty list-detectors --region <region> --output json, then aws guardduty get-detector --detector-id <id>

requests.title: AWS Config recorders and recording status
requests.how: aws configservice describe-configuration-recorders and describe-configuration-recorder-status, per region, as JSON

requests.title: AWS Backup plans and protected resources
requests.how: aws backup list-backup-plans --region <region> --output json

requests.title: AWS default encryption settings for storage
requests.how: aws ec2 get-ebs-encryption-by-default --region <region>; aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket <bucket>

requests.title: AWS account S3 public access block settings
requests.how: aws s3control get-public-access-block --account-id <account-id> --output json

requests.title: Entra Conditional Access policies export
requests.how: Microsoft Graph GET /identity/conditionalAccess/policies (Policy.Read.All), saved unchanged as JSON

requests.title: Entra security defaults and authentication methods policy
requests.how: Microsoft Graph GET /policies/identitySecurityDefaultsEnforcementPolicy and GET /policies/authenticationMethodsPolicy, saved as JSON

requests.title: Entra privileged role assignments
requests.how: Microsoft Graph GET /roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments with $expand=principal (RoleManagement.Read.Directory), saved as JSON

requests.title: Access review sign-off for in-scope systems
requests.how: Entra access review results or the access review pack output, with the reviewer's sign-off and date

requests.title: Leavers list with account disablement dates
requests.how: HR system report of leavers in the period, joined to the date each account was disabled, saved as CSV

requests.title: Joiners list with screening and agreement records
requests.how: HR system report of joiners in the period with screening outcome and signed agreement dates, saved as CSV

requests.title: Security awareness training completion report
requests.how: Training platform or HR system completion report for all staff, with completion dates, saved as CSV

requests.title: Policy acknowledgement records
requests.how: HR system or policy tool report of staff acknowledgements of the current policies, with dates

requests.title: Approved information security policy set with approval dates
requests.how: The current policy documents with version, approver and approval date; export the version history from the document store

requests.title: Risk assessment and risk treatment record
requests.how: The risk register with owner, rating, treatment and review date for each risk, exported from where it is kept

requests.title: Internal audit or control self-assessment record
requests.how: The internal audit report or self-assessment, with the date, scope and follow-up actions

requests.title: Device and asset inventory export
requests.how: Device management console: export the managed device list with owner, platform and last check-in, saved as CSV

requests.title: Device compliance policies and compliance status
requests.how: Microsoft Graph GET /deviceManagement/deviceCompliancePolicies (DeviceManagementConfiguration.Read.All), saved as JSON

requests.title: Vulnerability scan results and remediation tickets
requests.how: Scanner report for the period, plus the ticket export showing each high and critical finding with open and close dates

requests.title: GitHub Dependabot alerts and security settings
requests.how: gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/dependabot/alerts --paginate; gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/vulnerability-alerts

requests.title: GitHub branch protection or rulesets on the release branch
requests.how: gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/branches/<branch>/protection; gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/rules/branches/<branch>

requests.title: Merged pull requests with approvals for the period
requests.how: gh pr list --repo <owner>/<repo> --state merged --limit 1000 --json number,mergedAt,author,reviews

requests.title: Emergency and out-of-process change tickets
requests.how: Ticket system export of changes marked emergency or expedited in the period, with approver and after-the-fact review

requests.title: Incident register with post-incident reviews
requests.how: Ticket system export of every security incident in the period with severity, timeline and review notes; state explicitly if there were none

requests.title: Incident response exercise or test record
requests.how: Notes or report from the tabletop or live exercise, with date, attendees and actions

requests.title: Security alert review log
requests.how: Ticket or log export showing each alert review with date, reviewer and outcome, for the month

requests.title: Business continuity and recovery plan with review record
requests.how: The current plan with version, owner and last review date, plus the record of the latest recovery test

requests.title: Vendor attestation register and review
requests.how: The vendor list with criticality, owner, latest report or certificate dates and the review outcome, as CSV

requests.title: Google Workspace 2-step verification enforcement
requests.how: Admin console: Reporting, then Security, then 2-Step Verification enrolment and enforcement report, exported as CSV

requests.title: Google Workspace admin roles and audit log settings
requests.how: Admin console: Account, then Admin roles, listing each role's members; Reporting, then Audit and investigation settings
